blocks.text: LOS ANGELES— Luka Doncic had 28 points and eight assists, Jake LaRavia added 15 points and 10 rebounds, and the Los Angeles Lakers avenged a surprising home loss to the Jazz five days earlier with a 109-94 victory over Utah in the NBA on Monday night. Matisse Thybulle scored 14 points for the Lakers, who have won 11 of 12 overall despite that 109-97 loss to the Jazz last Wednesday, ending a nine-game winning streak.
